entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnet test` support for traversal projects in .NET 10 #51316
  • Enable building multiple projects at the command line #51311
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.4xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #51308
  • Rules are missing documentation #51305
  • [REGRESSION] System.IO.Compression version problems for Net Framework targets #51304
  • [WebToolsE2E] The 8.0/9.0 implicit runtime(8.0.19/9.0.8) is not the same with VS carries(8.0.21/9.0.10) after installing SDK 10.0 GA. #51303

Closed

  • Can't create non RID-specific tool package if compiling with RuntimeIdentifier set #51199
    10.0.1xx
  • [xUnit v3] Catastrophic failure: Test process did not return valid JSON (non-object) when using .NET 10 RC2 #51270
  • dotnet test is broken in net10 rc2 in Microsoft.Testing.Platform (MTP) #51283
  • About .NET10 official release, which VS version will be required? #51266
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #51285
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #51302

Created

  • Enable manual workflow runs to update man pages #51318
  • Stop using Ubuntu 20.04 #51317
  • Set Microsoft_CodeAnalysis_BuildHost_SkipRuntimeVersionCheck #51314
    Area-AspNetCore

    Servicing-approved
  • Logging cleanup #51307
  • [automated] Update man pages #51301
  • Add CA1876 analyzer to detect misuse of AsParallel() in foreach loops #51287
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.1xx' => 'release/8.0.3xx' #51284

Merged

  • Restore rules without documentation #51315
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Revert Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' into darc-release/9.0.3xx-dd349698-0d4f-47dc-984b-9b4cdb884111 #51306

  • Enable CI builds for 2xx branch #50985
  • Add support for building tool packages with runtime identifier set without building RID-specific packages #51281
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.1xx
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0.3xx #51243
  • Don't fall back to .NET Standard package pruning for .NET Framework #51288
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.0
  • Fix CA1516 diagnostic resource string mapping to display correct title and description #51299
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0.4xx #51244
  • Add CA2026 analyzer: Prefer JsonElement.Parse over JsonDocument.Parse().RootElement #51209
  • [wasm] Always update SDK pack version from workload to current for down level TFM #51269
    Area-WasmSdk, 11.0.1xx
  • [main] [Blazor] Remove unnecessary update to the Blazor webassembly js file #51274
    11.0.1xx
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.1xx' => 'release/9.0.3xx' #51286
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #51262
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51291
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51296
    Area-CodeFlow
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0.1xx #51242
